refundPolicy.summary: A purchaser may request a refund within 14 calendar days of purchase if no package download has been redeemed. Duplicate charges will be remedied. A materially defective file will be repaired, replaced, or refunded after verification. Statutory rights that cannot be waived remain unaffected.
refundPolicy.requestMethod: email the configured support address or use the verified order refund-request endpoint
refundPolicy.decisionBoundary: A request is not an automatic approval. Download redemption, duplicate-charge evidence, file integrity, and applicable law are reviewed and the outcome is recorded through the payment provider.

support.channel: brand-owned Aloha AI email configured through COMMERCE_SUPPORT_EMAIL
support.responseTarget: initial response within two business days
support.scope: file access, billing records, duplicate-charge remediation, defect reports, refund requests, and clarification of the acquired version; no legal, medical, compliance, platform, or implementation assurance

license.scope: one named legal organization; internal implementation, internal adaptation, internal training, and retention of the acquired immutable version
prohibited: representation as legal, medical, compliance, scientific, or platform assurance
